lines.text: For free, not as a service!
Many learners say: Can I get this as a service?
Better: Can I get this for free?
Service means help from a worker, not a free gift.
For free! Can I get this for free?

data.wrong: Can I get this as a service?
data.right: Can I get this for free?
data.why: Service means help from a worker, not a free gift.

native.tip: 한국어에서는 공짜로 주는 것을 ‘서비스’라고 하지만, 영어 service는 도움이라는 뜻이에요. 공짜는 for free! 이렇게 말해요 👉 “Can I get this for free?”

en.tip: Service means help from a worker, not a free gift. Say “Can I get this for free?”
en.caption: Do you say “Can I get this as a service” in English? 😅 Service means help from a worker, not a free gift, so say for free! “Can I get this for free?” is right. Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
